title: Canton Signal Feed — Infiniti Signals
description: Canton Signal Feed is the Infiniti Signals intelligence layer for the Canton Network ecosystem: twice-hourly editions covering ecosystem, product, partnerships, funding, regulation and security news across Canton Network and its registry companies, published directly to the web page as soon as each edition is generated.
generator: Canton Signal Feed briefing pipeline (Infiniti Signals)

items.title: Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 3:42 PM ET)
- **Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton** — Upflam has dropped its invite-only access: anyone can now sign up, create a Canton wallet and take payments through payment links, invoices, donation pages, embeddable buttons, recurring AutoPay and a WooCommerce plugin, with a 0.1% fee on incoming payments (CC Space)
- **First trades of tokenized U.S. equity under SEC Innovation Exemption executed on Canton** — Shares of Canton Strategic Holdings (NASDAQ: CNTN) traded on November 4 on TSV, the permissioned venue for tokenized NMS stocks on Canton, with Five North as seller, DRW Cumberland as buyer and Flowdesk as liquidity provider; Fairmint, the SEC-registered transfer agent, recorded the shares and the trades settled atomically, the first of their kind under the SEC's September 17 Innovation Exemption (Morningstar)
- **Wells Fargo among organizations awarded MainNet validator allocations** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group awarded additional MainNet validator node allocations, including three to Wells Fargo alongside Visoty, Cartumi, Winsnip, Winnode and Otoclick, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments (CC Space)
- **Canton Foundation launches Community Research Grants with up to 50,000 CC per month** — The Foundation has launched Canton Community Research Grants, with up to 50,000 CC per month available beginning in November 2026 at the Foundation's discretion for original research and educational content (CoinStats)

Network: CC $0.08917 | Market cap $3.57B | 24h volume $8.76M | Supply 40.04B CC; milestone: Canton handles $300 billion to $400 billion in repo daily, much of it through Broadridge's Distributed Ledger Repo platform, according to Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz at Token2049 (DropsTab for market data; CoinStats for the repo milestone)

items.title: DTCC plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)
- **DTCC plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027** — The service launched on Canton and DTCC's private network on October 28, so Canton remains its first live venue; the announcement signals a future multi-network strategy rather than a move away from Canton (CoinMarketCap)
- **Blockdaemon faces losing 4.0 escrowed Super Validator weight after its milestones expire** — Blockdaemon's adoption milestones under CIP-94 expired without being met, so the Foundation has proposed stripping the 4.0 escrowed reward weight held via MPCH in the first visible application of the Super Validator Accountability Framework, with voting running until November 17 (CC Space)
- **Rome Protocol launches Ostia, a zero-knowledge EVM chain settling on Canton** — Ostia is live on Canton DevNet as an Ethereum-compatible chain whose blocks are proved with zero-knowledge proofs and settled in a single Canton transaction, with a bridge that moves Canton Coin and ERC-20 tokens between the two sides (CC Space)
- **Digital Asset and the American Idea Foundation select Canton for a three-state RISE benefits pilot** — The pilot is planned for Q1 2027 pending federal approval, with Canton coordinating payment rules while limiting access to recipients' sensitive information; locations and participating programs have not been disclosed (CoinMarketCap)

Network: CC $0.0890 | Market cap $3.56B (rank 27) | 24h volume $9.20M | Supply 40.04B CC; milestone: Featured App Guidance v2.0b is in force, cutting the per-transaction featured app reward cap to $0.79 with activity markers required to match burned fees one-for-one (HookScreener for market data; CC Space for the milestone)

items.title: Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin** — The Foundation approved almost 15.8 million CC, worth about $1.55 million, to fund RedStone's open-source Canton Access and Privacy Standard (CAPS) tool, letting institutions value transactions from a shared reference price without revealing their agreed settlement amounts; initial pricing covers tokenized funds, private-market assets and structured products under the Apache 2.0 license (Cointelegraph)
- **Uber completes 24/7 treasury pilot on Canton with HSBC, Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks** — Uber used HSBC Tokenized Deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares on Tradeweb through delivery-versus-payment transactions on Canton via Fireblocks, and liquidated part of the holding over a weekend while continuing to earn yield throughout the investment lifecycle (HSBC)
- **Societe Generale accepts $10 million in tokenized Treasuries as collateral on Canton** — The bank's Prime Services & Clearing division accepted the DTCC-tokenized Treasuries as eligible collateral, reflecting them in its existing back-office and collateral systems, and intends to develop support for recurring collateral movements and explore onchain repo financing (Societe Generale)
- **Circle reports 379.9 million Canton Coin held at September 30** — Circle's quarterly filing shows 379,921,930 CC with a fair value of about $48.0 million at September 30, 2026, up in quantity from 367,760,063 CC held at December 31, 2025 (Circle Form 10-Q)

Network: CC $0.0885 | Market cap $3.54B | 24h volume $16.35M | Supply 40.04B CC; milestone: more than 600 institutions onboarded across the Canton ecosystem (CoinMarketCap for market data; Cointelegraph for the milestone)

items.title: Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130** — The November 10 vote passed with 11 in favour and two non-votes, giving the pair one shared arrangement to earn up to 10 reward weight through verified milestones tied to regulated customer access, institutional settlement and collateral integration (CantonNews)
- **OpenZeppelin Daml library and four reference designs clear Canton Dev Fund vote** — The security firm's open-source Daml contracts library and reference designs for a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and a fourth design were approved, giving Canton builders vetted, reusable building blocks (CC Space)
- **SEC staff view Canton Coin as a digital commodity in November 3 no-action letter** — Division of Corporation Finance staff said they would not recommend enforcement over programmatic minting of CC by Super Validators, Validators and app providers as described; the letter is a staff position only and does not address secondary-market trading (Unchained)
- **CIP-0129 universal burn timeline points to private synchronizers in Q1 2027** — The first phase would apply universal fee burning to private synchronizers, described as ambitious rather than a firm deadline, with volume-based pricing estimated for Q3 2027 (CoinMarketCap)

Network: CC $0.08859 | Market cap $3.55B (rank 26) | 24h volume $11.54M | Supply 40.03B CC; milestone: CIP-0130 adds a path to a new weight-10 Super Validator arrangement on the Global Synchronizer (CoinDesk for market data; CantonNews for the validator milestone)

items.title: Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives
items.content_text:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 10:33 AM ET)
- **Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives** — Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz set out the sequence in an X Space: tokenized equities first, following the first trades under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, then repo trading, derivatives and private assets (BSCN)
- **Progmat signs with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton** — The MOU builds tokenized JGBs (tJGB) with live pilot testing this month by a working group of more than 68 institutions, including MUFG, targeting 24/7 on-chain repo settlement (Genfinity)
- **DTCC Tokenization Service is live on Canton, covering Treasuries, equities and ETFs** — The service launched October 28 with Morgan Stanley reported as an early user; DTCC also co-chairs Canton's governance alongside Euroclear (Cryptensive)

Network: CC $0.0909 | Market cap $3.6B (rank 27) | 24h volume $12.7M | Supply 40.0B CC (CoinGecko via Crypheat)
